title: Bind at least one test to an acceptance of every feature that owns WMBTs

facts.note: Topology roots come from the `topology:` keys in atdd-bun.yaml (defaults plan_root=plan, test_root=tests/wagons, e2e_root=e2e, source_root=src/wagons). Changes under any root, or to atdd-bun.yaml itself, can change which tests are bound to which feature acceptances. Paths inside vendored or generated trees (node_modules, dist, build, _generated) are filtered out.

Requires parsing the plan to find features owning WMBTs, then searching all scanned tests for any test bound to one of that feature's acceptances (atdd_topology validator). Fires only when no such bound test exists anywhere; test location is not part of this finding.

values: feature or WMBT added to plan
test bound to a feature acceptance removed or unbound
facts.note: Diff-level plan/test-binding or root-configuration change; relevant only if it leaves a feature with WMBTs with no bound test.

fires: A plan feature declares WMBTs but no test anywhere in the scanned tests is bound to any of its acceptances.
The only test bound to a feature's acceptance (unit or end-to-end) is deleted or unbound, leaving the feature's WMBTs with no bound test.
A topology root in atdd-bun.yaml is changed so that no scanned test bound to a feature's acceptances remains (e.g. the only bound tests now fall outside every scanned root).
doesNotFire: A feature that owns no WMBTs has no tests.
A feature with WMBTs has at least one test bound to one of its acceptances, wherever that test is placed.
Files inside vendored or generated trees (node_modules, dist, build, _generated).

given: A plan feature owns one or more WMBTs (behaviours declared for it in the plan)
when: the topology gate checks whether any test is bound to that feature's acceptances
then: At least one test is bound to one of the feature's acceptances.
prefer: Add a test beneath the feature bound to one of its acceptances.
avoid: Leaving declared feature behaviour (WMBTs) with no test bound to any of its acceptances.
unless: Vendored and generated trees (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`) are never scanned.
why: Behaviour declared and never tested is a silent gap.
evidence: The atdd_topology validator reports no feature that owns WMBTs without at least one test bound to one of its acceptances.
A failing fixture (feature with WMBTs, no bound test) is flagged by the package guard.
verifier_detail: Roots come from the `topology:` keys `plan_root`, `source_root`, `test_root`, `e2e_root` in `atdd-bun.yaml` (defaults `plan`, `src/wagons`, `tests/wagons`, `e2e`).
Skip vendored and generated trees (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`); they are never scanned.
Coverage is satisfied by any scanned test bound to one of the feature's acceptances; placement beneath the feature is the recommended fix, not a condition of this rule.
Severity 3, disposition strict (source statement: "Package rule, strict.").
audit: Term package_rule: a rule of this package's own gates (`atdd-bun.*`), realized by a package guard rather than a canonical planner node.
It is held to the same per-rule checks as every convention: a convention, strict, a failing fixture, relationship edges.
Summary: A feature with WMBTs has a test bound to one of its acceptances.

additions.text: Gloss '(behaviours declared for it in the plan)' for WMBTs.
additions.justification: Usability: coder-facing fields otherwise leave WMBT undefined; the gloss follows the source's own rationale ('Behaviour declared') and adds no obligation.

additions.text: Validator report and failing fixture as compliance evidence.
additions.justification: Derived from implementation (validator atdd_topology) and the package_rule term requiring a failing fixture.

additions.text: Activation path facts include <e2e_root>/** and atdd-bun.yaml, plus a fires example for root reconfiguration that leaves no bound test.
additions.justification: E2E tests and root configuration (both in the source topology_settings term) can change whether a bound test exists; widens activation only, adds no obligation.

additions.text: Clarification that placement beneath the feature is the recommended fix, not a coverage condition.
additions.justification: Auditor fix: prevents the verifier from strengthening the binding obligation into a placement obligation.

trace.note: strict disposition kept verbatim; no expanded semantics
